title: Lokalna podatność normalna koła przy zamrożonym manifoldzie
question: Czy lokalna podatność normalnego kontaktu wheel-ground zmniejsza drgania i szczyty obciążenia bez zmiany geometrii, topologii manifoldu ani zachowania stycznego?
hypothesis: Zmniejszenie wheel-specific contact Hertz da mierzalne ugięcie i obniży pionowe piki, a zakres pośredni zachowa energię, trwałość kontaktu oraz sterowanie lepiej niż skrajnie miękki wariant.

locked_factors.geometry: b3Wheel profile and cornerRadius bit-identical to 241fe10 baseline
locked_factors.manifold_topology: strict rigid support; identical point count and feature IDs
locked_factors.contact_damping_ratio: world value during first Hertz sweep

confounds: Changing damping together with Hertz would prevent attribution.
Changing crown/profile or manifold point count would reintroduce the topology confound removed by WHEEL-RIGID-01.
Global world contact softness would affect chassis, props and every other collision.
Tuning vehicle feeling before the tire decision could mask the physical effect.
Comparing runs with different time step, substeps or warm-up windows would invalidate energy and peak metrics.

levels.rig: single loaded wheel / quarter-car contact rig
levels.purpose: Isolate normal compliance, compression and energy response before vehicle coupling.
levels.entry_gate: Zero-override parity with 241fe10 and identical manifold IDs/counts.
levels.exit_gate: Repeatable compression curve, finite metrics, no topology drift and at least one candidate distinguishable from baseline.

levels.rig: full JV vehicle on plate and controlled bump
levels.purpose: Transfer the Q2 mechanism to sprung mass without changing vehicle tuning.
levels.entry_gate: Q2 decision packet is READY_FOR_ANALYSIS and a candidate range is selected without changing locked factors.
levels.exit_gate: Straight and bump runs repeat; acceleration/travel/energy effects agree in sign with Q2 and contact persistence remains stable.

levels.rig: full vehicle on triangle mesh and controlled corner
levels.purpose: Check transfer to real terrain topology and steering load.
levels.entry_gate: Q3 transfer succeeded without retuning suspension or steering.
levels.exit_gate: No new seam/corner regression, performance remains acceptable and Jozz completes manual feeling gate.

metrics: normal impulse and reconstructed force curve
contact point count, load-bearing point count and feature-ID persistence
energy loss per distance and terminal speed
promotion_rules: A level may advance only after its baseline and every promoted candidate are repeated from the same immutable proposal.
A candidate with topology drift, non-finite metrics or missing artifacts is INCONCLUSIVE, not a win.
Q2 must identify a mechanism before Q3 vehicle testing.
Q3 must preserve the sign of the Q2 effect before Q4 terrain testing.
No default vehicle parameter changes are allowed inside WHEEL-SOFT-03.
Status SUPPORTED or REFUTED is assigned after analysis, never by the runner.
manual_gates: Jozz checks for obvious sinking, delayed steering response, bouncing and unnatural sticky contact in Q4.
Any feeling change is recorded but does not automatically reject the mechanism because the current vehicle tune is provisional.
A visible or audible regression must be reproducible before reopening manifold geometry.
blockers: Implement a wheel-local normal softness override with zero/default parity in both convex and mesh contact preparation paths.
Expose machine-readable Q2 metrics without changing the existing baseline scene.
Add a headless command contract for one case that writes metrics.json into {case_dir}.
Add tests proving local softness does not alter friction, manifold topology, feature IDs or non-wheel contacts.
